evaluation_groups.label: Eligibility
evaluation_groups.purpose: Submission and eligibility: official declarations, eligibility evidence, Tender Security, qualification evidence and any published reservation eligibility, each pass/fail.

evaluation_groups.label: Technical compliance
evaluation_groups.purpose: One pass/fail gate fed by every mandatory goods, technical, warranty/support, related-service and acceptance check, each keeping its own evidence and reason. No weights or scores.

evaluation_groups.label: Financial
evaluation_groups.purpose: Arithmetic and financial evaluation of the published price schedules under the lowest-evaluated-responsive treatment.

evaluation_groups.label: Award
evaluation_groups.purpose: Award under the published rule. Consumes the prior governed group results; no response maps to it directly.

A reservation category outside None, Youth, Women or Persons with disabilities
A County-residents restriction without an applicable verified rule, approved overlap treatment or released rendering/evidence rule
Multiple currencies or alternative price schedules
A Requisition without authorised structured technical requirements and objective acceptance checks
